executiveSummary: Friday's Tokyo rally was narrow and technology-led. Weekend developments materially changed the Monday setup: the U.S.-Iran conflict escalated after Friday PTS, OPEC+ kept October output policy unchanged while Hormuz disruptions persist, and China announced a $54bn state-bank/insurer capital injection. Energy and defense retain the strongest unpriced weekend catalyst; BOJ tightening expectations support banks but pressure high-duration growth. AI/semiconductor momentum remains valid, but Friday's strong gains raise opening-fade risk. The prior calendar entry for Japan GDP on Sep 7 was incorrect; the Apr-Jun second preliminary GDP release is Tuesday Sep 8 at 08:50 JST.
